method.browser: Isolated Chrome, hardware renderer recorded below; Vite serves existing prepared world, HMR/network rooms disabled.
method.ab: Fixed scene and camera. 12 warmup + 20 measured render/gl.finish frames per sample. Paired baseline before/after each toggle. Effects overlap, savings must not be added.
method.live: Actual game loop, real swing activity and camera rotation; CPU update/render submission and asynchronous EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 GPU time. This is separate from forced gl.finish A/B tests.
